newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar edges up in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar edges up in listless trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar edged higher on Monday, closing in the middle of the day's trading range in very quiet activity.
The unit finished at T$27.484 per U.S. dollar, up from Saturday's T$27.487 close. Turnover through brokers was a meagre US$135.5 million.

"The Taiwan dollar bounced right off at T$27.482," said a foreign bank dealer. "There could have been some dealers testing resistance." He said the idea that demand from foreign funds would propel the currency higher might have fuelled the buying. "The volume was too small to matter," he added.
